clues.text: Jesus told His disciples that He was the true one, His Father tended it, and they were its branches.
In prison, Pharaoh's cupbearer told Joseph he dreamed of one with three branches whose clusters ripened.
East of Nineveh, God made one grow up to shade Jonah's head, then sent a worm to wither it.
Micah foresaw a day when each man sits under his own one and his own fig tree, unafraid.
At the Last Supper, Jesus said He would not drink of its fruit again until His Father's kingdom.
During a famine at Gilgal, a prophet's son picked gourds from a wild one, and Elisha's stew turned deadly.
A psalmist said God brought one out of Egypt, drove out the nations, and planted it in their land.
